fields.headline: Our virtual assistant gave incorrect advice about payment verification
fields.whatHappened: Between October 28 and November 3, Harbor Assist told some customers they did not need to complete a payment verification. That advice was wrong.
fields.whoIsAffected: Customers who asked the assistant about payment verification in that period. We are contacting them directly.
whatWeAreDoing: We turned off advice answers on November 3.
We are reviewing every affected conversation.
We are checking which reporting duties apply to us.
whatYouCanDo: If you skipped a verification, complete it in the app or call us.
You will not be charged a fee for the delay.
fields.whatWeDoNotKnow: We have not yet confirmed whether any customer lost money. We will update this notice by November 6.
